## name: Feature request about: Suggest an improvement or a new feature for VICTUBYTE title: "[FEATURE] " labels: enhancement assignees: ""

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

Describe the problem, limitation, or difficulty you would like to solve.

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Why would this be useful?

- Gameplay
- Learning experience
- Cybersecurity education
- Accessibility
- Performance
- User experience

## Possible implementation

If you have ideas about how this feature could work, describe them here.
